description:
The 2024 Chevrolet Equinox LT is a practical and well-equipped compact SUV that builds on the value of the base trim with a suite of comfort, convenience, and safety features designed for everyday driving and family-friendly versatility.

Power & Performance
The Equinox LT is powered by a 1.5-liter turbocharged four-cylinder engine paired with a smooth automatic transmission, delivering a balanced mix of efficiency and capability with EPA-estimated fuel economy averaging around 26 mpg city and 31 mpg highway in front-wheel-drive form. An available all-wheel-drive system offers added traction in varied road conditions.

Interior Comfort & Practicality
Step inside and the LT enhances comfort over the base model with features like dual-zone automatic climate control, heated front seats, and an 8-way power-adjustable driver s seat with power lumbar support. The cabin s design prioritizes passenger space and cargo flexibility, with around 29.9 cu ft of cargo room behind the rear seats and up to **63.9 cu ft with them folded down.

Technology & Connectivity
Tech features include an intuitive infotainment system with smartphone integration (Apple CarPlay® and Android Auto ), a multi-color driver information display, and connectivity options that help keep passengers entertained and drivers informed.

Safety & Driver Assistance
Safety is strong for the class: standard Chevrolet Safety Assist technologies and driver aids on the LT include Automatic Emergency Braking, Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning, Rear Cross-Traffic Alert, Lane Change Alert with Side Blind Zone Alert, and Front and Rear Park Assist all helping to boost confidence on the road.

Overall Impression
The 2024 Equinox LT delivers a thoughtful balance of comfort, technology, and everyday utility. It s a compelling choice for drivers who want a stylish compact SUV with useful amenities and strong safety features, without stepping up to the more expensive upper trims.

Safety is also a top priority, with features like the rear vision camera, OnStar emergency communication system, and a suite of airbags to protect you and your passengers.
